# Sycophancy
[color=#999999][italic]...is a traitors-focused show with parasitic undertones[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=#ff0000]Traitors[/color] and [color=yellowgreen]Parasites[/color]
Key Identities: [color=yellowgreen]Parasites[/color]
## Summary
Sycophancy is a standard Traitor masquerade with Parasites thrown into the mix.
There's no guarantee that anyone acting suspicious is a Traitor opposed to a Parasite looking to die and spread, so be cautious trying to take out any targets.
Identifying the types of Parasites can help tremendously, there is only a few to start and figuring out if you're dealing with Burstworms or Barnacles can help prevent infections in the future, assuming there's any crew left afterwards.
